name: DroidCam
author: saurasanchezpablo
description: Use your phone as a webcam with DroidCam: connects at login over Wi-Fi or USB, reconnects when the stream drops, and puts zoom, focus, torch, mirror and a setup check in the bar.

barWidget.description: Phone webcam status and controls. Left click for details, controls and settings, middle click to connect or disconnect, right click to reconnect.

schema.label: Connection
schema.description: auto: USB when a phone is plugged in, Wi-Fi otherwise · wifi · ios (iPhone over USB, needs usbmuxd) · adb (Android over USB, needs adb).

schema.label: Phone address
schema.description: The Wi-Fi IP shown in the DroidCam app, e.g. 192.168.1.50.

schema.label: Port
schema.description: The DroidCam port shown in the app.

schema.label: Camera device
schema.description: The loopback device to write to, e.g. /dev/video0. Automatic when empty (the DroidCam driver first).

schema.label: Resolution
schema.description: Only used with plain v4l2loopback; the DroidCam driver sets its own size.

schema.label: Audio
schema.description: Also use the phone as a microphone (needs the snd-aloop module).

schema.label: Take over
schema.description: Close another running DroidCam client (the DroidCam app window or droidcam-cli) instead of waiting for it.

schema.label: Only while in use
schema.description: Stream only while an app has the camera open, to save the phone's battery.

schema.label: Stop after idle (seconds)
schema.description: With 'Only while in use': how long to keep streaming after the last app closes the camera.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: When the camera connects, disconnects, or needs setup.

schema.label: Hide when off
schema.description: Hide the bar icon while the camera is not streaming. Use 'omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.saurasanchezpablo.droidcam' to open it.

schema.label: Preview
schema.description: A small picture in the popup, refreshed every 2 seconds while it is open. Needs ffmpeg.

schema.label: droidcam-cli path
schema.description: Only if droidcam-cli is not on PATH.
